Notes From Your Bookseller

Author and podcaster Aaron Mahnke delivers a fascinating deep dive into the intersection between science and folklore in the 1800s that led to a widespread panic around the myth of the American vampire.

An engrossing and macabre exploration of the folklore and early medical practices that led to the New England Vampire Panic in the 1890s, from critically acclaimed podcaster and bestselling author Aaron Mahnke.

What would drive a man to exhume the body of his daughter and remove her heart? That question has haunted Aaron Mahnke, creator and host of the award-winning podcast Lore. Fueled by a decade of research, Mahnke excavates the past to understand the hysteria that fueled the ghastly exh...
